messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>

#define ld long double
#define ll long long

using namespace std;

int main()
{
    ld x,y,n;
    
    cin>>x>>y>>n;
    ld min=numeric_limits<ld>::max();
    ld ax,ay;
    ld mod=x/y;
    for(ld i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
            ll a=mod*i;
            ld t1=fabs((ld)(a)/i-mod);
            ld t2=fabs((ld)(a+1)/i-mod);
            if(t1<=t2 && t1<min)
            min=t1,ax=a,ay=i;
            else if(t2<min)
            min=t2,ax=a+1,ay=i;    
            
    }
    cout<<ax<<'/'<<ay<<endl;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
